reviews.text: Light understated glow with very fine glitter. Looking forward to wearing over Xmas. Not sure which coloured I prefer as dewy moon was out of stock. Milky moon is less obvious in my opinion, so great for daily wear and rose moon shows up in my brown skin more so is better for a night out.
reviews.zh: 輕盈低調嘅光澤，閃粉非常幽細。期待聖誕期間用。我未能決定鍾意邊個顏色，因為 dewy moon 缺貨。我覺得 milky moon 比較唔明顯，所以啱日常使用，而 rose moon 喺我嘅啡色皮膚上更加明顯，所以更適合夜間外出用。

reviews.text: I don’t really like this highlighter stick. First, the color payoff isn’t great—it’s not very pigmented. Also, if I apply it directly onto my face, it messes up my base makeup. Even when I gently pat it on with a sponge and set it with powder, the areas with highlighter still get cakey and come off really easily.
reviews.zh: 我唔太鍾意呢款提亮膏條。首先，發色唔太好，唔太有色素。另外，如果我直接塗喺面上，會搞亂我嘅底妝。就算我用海綿輕拍，再用散粉定妝，塗咗提亮嘅位置仍然會起餅，而且好容易脫落。

reviews.text: The Glint Stick Highlighter #02 Milky Moon gives a soft, luminous glow that looks natural and effortless. Its creamy stick formula glides smoothly over the skin without emphasizing texture, making it perfect for everyday use. The shade “Milky Moon” adds a delicate pearly sheen that brightens the high points of the face beautifully. It blends easily with fingers or a brush, lasts well throughout the day, and gives a radiant, dewy finish. A great choice for anyone who loves a subtle yet stunning highlight.
reviews.zh: Glint Stick Highlighter #02 Milky Moon 帶嚟柔和、發亮嘅光澤，睇落自然又不費力。佢嘅奶霜質感膏條配方順滑地推過皮膚，唔會突出紋理，所以啱日常使用。「Milky Moon」色號帶嚟精緻嘅珍珠光澤，將面部高點提亮得好靚。易用手指或者刷具推開，全日都持久，帶嚟亮澤嘅水潤妝效。對鍾意低調而又驚艷提亮效果嘅人嚟講，係好好嘅選擇。

reviews.text: Ok so I bought this highlighter wanting one that gives a natural “glossy” dewy look without the shimmer. I was a little worried that the shimmer would come out too obvious. I bought the fenty highlighter stick a long time ago when it first came out and it’s really dry and cakey. This is NOT. It melts like a balm into something more slippery and creamy with small shimmers. If you apply it directly on your cheek without patting or using a brush, it’s gorgeous, looks just like you piled on tons of skincare. If you pat it or press, you can feel the hydration and stickiness and the more you pat it, the less glossy it becomes as it absorbs into your skin, leaving behind only the glitter.
reviews.zh: 好啦，我買呢款提亮膏，係想要一款有「光澤」水潤感、又冇閃粉嘅自然效果。我有少少擔心閃粉會太明顯。我好耐之前買過 fenty 嘅提亮膏條，佢真係好乾身，又會起餅。呢款就唔係咁！佢會好似膏霜咁融化，變成一種更滑、更奶霜質感，帶有細細嘅閃粉。如果你直接塗喺面頰上，唔拍唔用刷，效果好靚，睇落好似塗咗好多護膚品咁。如果你拍或者壓，就會感覺到水潤同黏度，而且你拍得越多，光澤就越少，因為佢會滲入皮膚，最後只剩低閃粉。

reviews.text: This highlighter is THE dewy skin balm highlighter. I rub it on the back of my hand and then swipe it to my face with a dense brush or sometimes a sponge. The shine is insane, if you have more melanin I’d recommend the champagne shade or others with pigment rather than the translucent one.
reviews.zh: 呢款提亮膏真係超級水光感嘅 balm 提亮產品。我會先喺手背上塗開，然後用密刷或者有時用海綿掃到面上。光澤感超強，如果你膚色較深，我建議揀 champagne 色號，或者其他有色素嘅色號，唔好揀透明色。

reviews.text: I fell in love with these! I will apply a powder blush and put this over it for a natural dewy glow. I usually do not combine a dewy blush with this product. Milky moon is a clear light pink/white shade and goes well with cool tone makeup. Use this if Dewy Moon is too warm for you.
reviews.zh: 我真係愛上咗呢個！我會先塗粉質腮紅，再喺上面塗呢款，做出自然水潤光澤。我通常唔會將水潤腮紅同呢款產品一齊用。Milky moon 係清透嘅淺粉／白色色號，配冷色調妝容好啱。如果 Dewy Moon 對你嚟講太暖，就可以試吓呢款。

reviews.text: Whenever I see Youtubers use this product, it looks so good. It gives that nice sheer and effortless glow. However, whenever I use it looks way too sheer. It feels like I'm not getting any product on my face. I'm not sure if I'm applying it incorrectly, but I find myself never reaching for it. I like their powdered version a lot more!
reviews.zh: 每次睇 YouTuber 用呢款產品，都睇落好靚。佢會帶嚟好薄透又不費力嘅光澤。不過，我每次用，效果都好似太透明。感覺好似塗唔到產品喺面上咁。我唔肯定係咪我塗錯咗，但我發覺自己從來唔會拎嚟用。我更加鍾意佢哋嘅粉質版本！

reviews.text: I’ve always shied away from highlighters but got curious about this one due to the good reviews. It’s a perfect subtle dewy highlighter. I love the stick form, super easy to glide on then use your fingers to blend! With mask wearing I’m not sure it lasts the whole day but it doesn’t bother me too much!
reviews.zh: 我一向都唔太會用提亮產品，但係因為好評太多，所以對呢款有興趣。佢係一款完美、低調嘅水潤提亮產品。我好鍾意膏條形式，好易推開，然後用手指推勻就得！戴口罩嘅情況下，我唔肯定佢可以全日持久，但係我都唔太介意！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
